title: Squad Health Check session export
description: The facilitator recap of a finished session, downloaded as JSON and imported in a later session to compare each category with it.

voters.description: Number of people who could vote in the session (the facilitator only when they voted).

categories.description: The categories, in the order they were discussed.

name.description: Stable category key, matched across sessions whatever the language.

title.description: Title in the language of the export.

median.description: Median vote weight, from 1 (red, getting worse) to 9 (green, improving), possibly a half; null without votes.

notes.description: The facilitator's note for the category.
